q1_issues.issue: "at ninety" is stored as a free-standing (Measure sk_founder_1 age 90 year) with no link to the dying event, so it reads as an unconditioned standing age, and both the scale `age` and the unit `year` are supplied by the parser rather than stated in the text, which the Measure rule requires (a stated gradable adjective, else the stated dimension noun).

q2_gaps: "at <number>" age-at-event adjunct — no construction ties a Measure to the time of an event, and no scale or unit is specified when the text states neither a gradable adjective nor a dimension noun
notes: Patient for the intransitive change-of-state subject and the absence of any status atom for the bare simple present both follow the instruction set exactly.
